title: Mixed Event — What lies behind. What lies ahead.

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.
meta.Outline: With the song that made Mafuyu smile complete, positive responses from fans come flooding in. Meanwhile, Mizuki feels like the only one unable to get closer to the other members. One day, the group bumps into An, who has seen a side to Mizuki that the others haven't...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<How is it, K?
I tried out all of your suggestions and tried to fix up the ending...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The video syncs up with the chorus much better now. Let's go with this.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
I'm just glad we managed to figure everything out...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And thanks for helping me edit everything towards the end there, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Now I feel sleep deprived now because of that... Make sure to get some real sleep in tonight, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I will.
I'll start by sleeping in until noon!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Anyway, this means our song and music video are both done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We finally get to upload it. The song that made Mafuyu smile...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She and Kanade put so much effort into this song too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I hope this gets a ton of views!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hehe. I can't wait to see what people say about it, but I should probably hit the hay now... *Yawn*...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Great work, everyone.
This took a lot out of us, so we should all get some well-deserved rest.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Night.
Oh, I think I'll take a bath first...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I still feel really drowsy. I guess I did stay up pretty late last night.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's 10:00...?
I don't have school or work today, so I can go back to... Wait!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Our new song!
What are people saying about it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?! It has this many views already?! In less than half a day...?

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I didn't know they could make music like this.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I've had a lot on my mind lately, but I feel way better after hearing this song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The others really put everything they had into this song, so I couldn't be happier.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Especially Kanade... She really is an incredible person...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It all started with Mafuyu saying, “This isn't good enough.” And now, she's found a way to reach not just Mafuyu, but all these other people...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's not just Kanade either. Mafuyu and Ena are also really amazing people.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're taking a hard look at themselves and facing their problems despite how uncomfortable that might be.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm still stuck in the same place...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? A message? At this time?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You awake? Did you see the view count?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Ena...
She's awake already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I saw! Isn't it awesome?! It's like double what we usually get!> And send...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Everyone's saying that the video goes really well with the music, so this one might end up becoming our best one yet, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah!
I hope K and Yuki get to enjoy this too!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <This also means we should pick a date to do an after party. When are you gonna be free, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <My work schedule hasn't been decided yet, but I should know sometime this week. I'll let you know when I find out.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Okay.
I'll ask K and Yuki in the meantime.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <These things aren't as fun when you're not there.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But Ena really is a good person...
I mean, she's willing to put up with me like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know that I haven't made any progress up until now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I hope that I'll become closer with them, someday...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah. Cheers.
Way too excited as usual. Mind calming down a bit?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then there's you two. This is a party, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What are you looking at on your phone, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! You almost never do that, Mafuyu! So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: There are a lot more longer comments than usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that? Not what everyone's been saying? Okay, sure but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, someone commented about my illustrations!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
They said, “Great use of color.”
I guess some people really do pay attention. I worked so hard on giving everything more light by using brighter colors!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... You just don't care, do you...?!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Our song is reaching all these people... I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, Kanade, that's right!
So let's celebrate and eat as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So here are some of my fries!
We should split some dessert later too♪

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here's your tea.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? You're not getting what Kanade got today?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: No, she got ramen with extra pork and I'm not very hungry right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay...? Then, why did you get that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You weren't really able to choose anything on your own like this up until recently, so maybe you have been making progress...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Fine, whatever.
Let's hope that you figure it out soon...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Now you're starting to bug me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh?! Seriously?!
What's that supposed to mean?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, girl! There, there!
Just try to settle down...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Isn't that what you say to calm down a horse?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And who exactly are you calling a horse?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Being with everyone like this really is fun.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like I can just be myself when I'm with them.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted from talking so much.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We started at noon but it's already getting dark.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup!
See you later on Nightcord...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I knew it!
Talk about a coincidence!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, where are you going...? Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hi, Kohane! Oh, Li'l Bro and Toya are here too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A-Akiyama!
I've been meaning to thank you for what you did for me during the School Festival...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's all good. There's no need to thank me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, Akiyama. How long's it been? Since the Summer Festival?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We haven't seen you in a while. How have you been?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it has been a while, but I've been good! More importantly, what are you guys all doing here?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We just did an event and were on our way home! Hm? Who's that with you...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, they're from that music group I was telling you about! We were just celebrating our latest song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Really? That's great!
I'm An Shiraishi, Mizuki's classmate.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
My name is Mafuyu Asahina.
It's a pleasure to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I could ask you the same.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, Akito, is she your sister?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Excuse me? Unfortunately?
Did you forget that I'm the eldest?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha!
You two are so close!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But it's nice to finally meet you! I'm glad we ran into each other like this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito talks about you all the time, so I've been waiting for a chance to chat with you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, Ena's being overwhelmed by An's cheerful persona!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, wait... You said that you're celebrating. Sorry for interrupting like this!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's okay. We were actually just about to call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Perfect.
That means we can split.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But before you do...!
Can I ask you something...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You said you're Mizuki's classmate, right, Shiraishi? I was wondering what Mizuki's like at school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: E-Ena, what's gotten into you all of a sudden...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, fair's fair. You're the one who keeps pressing my buttons, so think of it as payback!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'd have to say, “A free spirit!”
You never know when Mizuki's gonna be in class but doesn't actually get bad grades. I'm actually really jealous!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: At the same time, the teachers are all keeping an eye out for you because of all the time you've missed♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You didn't have to go that far, An!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Mizuki gets good grades?
I didn't see that coming...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Not just good at cramming for tests either. Mizuki's a really great teacher too.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, I'll have to excuse myself. I should get home before curfew...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Right.
I need to get started on our next demo too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we'll call things here too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Talk about a surprise. I didn't expect to bump into An there.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I guess it's not that unlikely or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still, I can't help but feel jittery.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Am I that worried about the others learning about who I am...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I wouldn't mind if it's them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I talked to some of my classmates about it when we started high school, so it's already out there.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Li'l Bro and Toya probably don't know, but even if they did...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Am I afraid of what'll happen if everyone in N25 were to find out...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If they did learn about me, what'll happen?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They'll accept me for who I am, and nothing will change, right?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, and we'll be able to keep making music like...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, the past doesn't matter right now.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The others are nicer than that.
They'll be more willing to understand.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know that. I sincerely believe that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I do tell them and can't go back to the way things were, I...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I need to go on Nightcord.
The others are probably waiting...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry. I don't feel great, so I'm gonna go to bed.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If I did log on, Ena would start asking me a bunch of questions.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't think I can deal with that right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Are you sure you're okay?
It's been pretty chilly lately, so dress warm when you sleep, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I have to tell them.
They need to know about me.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's not like I have to prove this to anyone...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Not telling them is making me feel worse and worse.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's like I'm pulling one over on the people I care about...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why is it so hard for me to just be me...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Geez, I stayed up through the night...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No matter how much I think about it, I won't actually be able to control what happens.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm way too focused on the present even though I know that they'll find out eventually.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I should be having fun right now instead of dwelling on this.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everything's gonna be just fine now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Thanks for waiting, K.
Sorry for being late!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<You're fine.
Yuki and I just got here.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha. I'm fine now!
I think that all-nighter took more out of me than I realized.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But I'm glad you're okay.
Anyway, shall we get started?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <The demo's going to take a little more time, but I'd like to hear what Yuki has to say about it before doing anything more to it...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <And Enanan, Amia, I'd also like to ask you both for any suggestions regarding motifs or other ideas.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You got it!
Let's give it our best shot♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, that's about it for me. Things are going pretty smoothly this time around, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, they are!
I'd really rather not have to pull another all-nighter.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, this has nothing to do with what we're talking about, but this new shop opened up in front of the station. Wanna go check it out?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! You can play all sorts of VR games there! How does next Sunday sound...?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <My club is having a practice match that day so I'll be busy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Okay, I won't put you through that... But you're free, right, Enanan?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, I'm busy too, you know? I promised my mom that I'd go out with her that day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No! That's strike three!
Dang... I really wanted to go too...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, okay. We can go some other time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, when's the last time Mizuki invited us out somewhere like this...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not since we went on that mystery tour as far as I know.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Does this mean Mizuki's figured something out about that other thing...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The demo for our new song's finished and was hoping that you'd listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, sure.
I'd like to as well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay. And please don't hold back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Humhumhuuum♪ I can't wait for our next song! I'm really looking forward to reading the lyrics too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, don't be like that!
Enaemon, Mafuyu's so cold...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You know perfectly well that you won't get much of a reaction from Mafuyu. Also, who's “Enaemon”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Not in the slightest, so quit calling me that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, she's right! Your songs have always been amazing, Kanade, you've been on fire with your last few!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I guess that's just the great Kanade Yoisaki for you! Alright, I'm gonna give the video everything I've got!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In your usual spot, I see?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No. You seemed to have something on your mind, so I was just wondering what exactly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It has nothing to do with you.
Why don't you go back now, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It was like you were staring at someone the entire time... Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is something going on with Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Took you long enough.
We were thinking about heading back since we're done listening to the demo, alright?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure you're okay? You weren't really all there just now, so maybe a screw came loose or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! I was joking♪
Anyway, let's head back and get to work!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay, I like these motifs.
Let's go with this.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yay!
Hehe. This video should be another good one♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, let's keep this pace up and get back to work!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Me too. I'll be muting myself for a while.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia, can you wait a second...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Something came up and it's gonna keep my mom busy, so I'm free to go to that place you were talking about. Wanna go?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The truth is that I told her that I'd be busy, but I'm just too worried about Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, does 10:00 outside the station like usual sound good? And try not to be late, okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, fine! You really didn't need to throw that last part in...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but... We can get a reservation for the VR section in the afternoon, so we can go shopping in the meantime!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sure, sounds good.
Just don't stay up too late watching anime, alright?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, I'm gonna get back to work now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
There you are.
Alright, let's... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, you said you didn't feel well the other day, so try not to push yourself too hard, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, why are you being so nice to me today...? Is a meteor about to hit? Is the world about to end...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, so shut up!
Is that any way to talk to someone showing concern for you?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! Sorry, my bad!
Everyone knows that you're really a nice person♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why does that feel like an insult?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, we gotta go!
Before the light turns red!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
White or pink...?
Such a tough decision...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What are you going on about?
If you don't decide soon, we're gonna miss our reservation.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But this white one goes perfectly with that skirt I bought the other day! At the same time, this pink one's super cute...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, I get it.
I'm going to use the restroom, so try to make a decision before I get back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This always happens. Mizuki always goes on a shopping spree or takes forever to pick something out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I guess this means I was worried over nothing. Thank goodness.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm not being kept at arm's length like before either, so I think we're moving in the right direction.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I should use this time to organize everything we just bought...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have some of Mizuki's things too, so I should probably sort everything out... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, hi.
I thought you went to the restroom...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are you really sure you're okay...? You looked awful just now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I... I did?
I think I'm just sleepy.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Cut it out!
Okay, you might be fine physically, but something's definitely going on!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, Ena, keep it down...!
Look, you're scaring the clerk.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I've told you this before, but you need to tell me if something's bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I may not always be able to help, but I can at least listen...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I guess I'm not as well as I thought I was! I'm fine otherwise, honest...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Geez, I did it again...
I made her worry about me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena is sharper than she lets on...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(My head... I feel dizzy...
What's happening...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I was handling everything just fine until now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have nothing to talk about...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh! Seriously, what's going on?!
I'm worried sick and this is what I get told?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why won't Mizuki tell me anything...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A reason, a simple explanation, anything...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Otherwise, I'm just gonna drive myself mad running around in circles in my head...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Maybe... Just maybe...
MEIKO might know something...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I wonder where everyone is...
You usually don't have to go very far to find them...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not like you to come here all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I know.
More importantly, I need to ask you about Mizuki. Would you mind?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Or rather, something's been going on for a while now, but Mizuki looked terrible the other day...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't know what's going on, I haven't been able to learn anything and just don't know what to do...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You were talking about Mizuki the other day with Luka, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did that have anything to do with what's going on now? If so, please, tell me...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's important to watch over them, but sometimes it's necessary to break something down or take it apart if it's stalled and won't start.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe that is why I'm here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If you're completely sure, can you tell me what you do know? Did anything seem odd to you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even if I did know what's going on with Mizuki, I have no intention of telling you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What? Why?
Can't you just tell me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because I believe that you or anyone else getting involved would not be beneficial.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You and the others need to face your problems on your own. I am only here to observe and see how everything unfolds...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's no way anyone can solve all of the problems they're facing on their own, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, look at me. I'm here now because everyone else was there for me in my time of need.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I'm sure talking about what's going on will help Mizuki feel a lot better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Make things worse? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm simply speaking from common sense...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Broad solutions by definition cannot benefit everybody.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The simple act of attempting to help someone can in turn cause them to suffer more.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
N-No, we're not!
We're not, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why are you so obsessed with helping Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And as far as I know, Ena is not one to bend to the will of others... She won't let herself...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (As a result, she struggles in situations where she becomes caught between her own ideals and what reality has to offer.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This may be what Mizuki needs right now... It very well could be the most effective approach.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your ability to watch over Mizuki in this manner may be the key to helping them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have nothing more to say.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What did you mean by that?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I went to ask for advice but came back even more confused...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right...
I think I see what she means by that now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, what is it that's apparently so taboo...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Did something that bad or unspeakable happen? But I just don't see Mizuki doing anything like that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh! This is impossible...!
See?! I'm driving myself mad by running around in circles in my head!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm so sick of feeling this way too...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your ability to watch over Mizuki in this manner may be the key to helping them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What did she mean...?
Watch over Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Man, I'm beat.
Why do classes have to be so long?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I'm glad I came to school today.
I wouldn't have been able to focus on anything if I stayed at home.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, I need to keep my attendance up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Brrr... I'm freezing.
It feels like winter.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But no one comes up here when it's cold out, so that's a plus.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why did things have to turn out this way? How did I end up caring about everyone so much?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Everything would be so much easier if I just didn't.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew from the start that I shouldn't get too involved with anyone too...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I mean, considering everything that's happened already...)
They're kind of a pain to deal with.
Are we getting the wrong idea?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Every time, I was so sure that this person or that person would understand...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I know that not everyone's like that now. Everyone in N25 especially...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But things will change if I do speak up...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They're all really nice and will probably try to treat me no differently.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We'd work on stuff like normal and talk about whatever...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wouldn't be able to bear it.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Would life be so much easier if everyone just vanished from this world?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that's never going to happen...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's like the complete opposite of the School Festival now. It's so empty and quiet...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
To look for you.
I couldn't get a hold of you on Nightcord or your phone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Do you know how tired I am now? I never would've figured out where you were if it weren't for Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. I went to visit your class and ran into her, so I decided to ask if she knew where you were.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
S-Sorry about yesterday, Ena!
For ditching you like that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You became worried based on how I was acting, right? I don't blame you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I'm okay now!
I must've been in a bad mood then and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, to be honest, it still bothers me but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm here to talk to you about something else today.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Something is bothering you, right?
Something really big.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. It's nothing, really!
I probably wasn't feeling great because of what's been happening lately.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're not fooling me.
That isn't going to work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have been staying up pretty late, which could be irritating my skin, you know? At this rate, it's gonna be as bad as yours, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What's with you today, Ena...?
Why are you all no-nonsense now...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let me be honest with you. I've been hoping that you'd talk to me about this ever since we went on that mystery tour.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Again, there's nothing to talk about...
Even if there was, it has nothing to do with you, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to keep seeing you like this, Mizuki, because whatever you're going through is starting to affect me too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And you know exactly what I mean.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whenever Kanade or Mafuyu seemed like they needed help, you wanted to be there for them, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's normal to want to help out a friend when they're in need.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
I don't know what to say...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Will things stay the same afterward if I tell her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I went to SEKAI on my own after what happened that day...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And MEIKO ended up telling me this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And if that's what you're dealing with, Mizuki, I don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You don't have to tell me if you really can't right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean I'm giving up!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I don't want to see you with that awful look on your face, and I want to help you in whatever way I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So please, tell me when you feel you're ready. I'll be waiting until then.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're joking, right? There's nothing else to it. I'm gonna wait for as long as I need to until you're ready to talk to me about this...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: As long as you need to...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It could be a really long time, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll just have to wait patiently by your side until then. Oh, FYI, I'm not letting you run away from this or me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Oh, Ena...
There's no way you're gonna be...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I have to tell her. She's genuinely worried about my well-being.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I need to believe in her, and find a way to tell her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much.
I feel a lot better now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't tell you right now, but when I feel ready... I hope you'll be willing to hear me out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm the worst when it comes to waiting, but I'll make a special exception for you.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So promise to tell me when you're ready...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, crap!
Class is about to start!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Really?
This is when your classes start? I never knew that!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Now I've done it.
I'm gonna be late...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But you're always tardy.
What's one more blotch on your record gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No, I'm not! Shut up!
I don't have time for that right now! Where'd I put my bag...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (The idea that she'd stay my friend forever if I never tell her actually crossed my mind...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (No, there's no such thing as “forever”. But I want to enjoy every second of what I have now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I want to keep having fun with N25... With Ena... So...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Haha. Ena's gonna be so mad when she realizes that...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Isn't there anyone out there who can tell her all this for me?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, time to go. Oh, Mizuki!
